day2_results.reading: Aurora stayed alive with a 2-0 elimination-match win.
9z took a map from Falcons but lost the best-of-three; Falcons advanced.
BetBoom won the elimination match and PARIVISION was eliminated.
FURIA won the Group B advancement match and advanced to the playoffs.

contrarian_rules.R1_coinflip_fade: not eligible: market gap is about 30 percentage points, above the 12-point threshold
contrarian_rules.R2_upset_swing: not eligible: 35% underdog chance and 20% ownership, but leverage 1.75 is below 2.0
contrarian_rules.R3_context_swing: not eligible: 20% underdog ownership is above the 10% ceiling

day3_fixtures.source_note: The 65% published pick-board estimate is its market+model line; the underlying market-only consensus was 66.4% for Aurora. The HotSpawn split is ownership only, never a probability input.

day3_fixtures.pick_status: provisional model only; not a HotSpawn-listed pick in the captured lobby snapshot
day3_fixtures.method: Repo's calibrated Valve-VRS logistic model: 17 priced calibration pairs, k=0.279849; VRS snapshot 2026-10-05. The reported 63% is an originated model estimate, not a bookmaker probability.
day3_fixtures.limitation: No validated two-sided bookmaker/exchange price was retained for this pairing. An EGamersWorld listing showed 1.8/1.8, but that is not sufficient evidence to assign a directional price; day-two form is contrary context (BetBoom beat PARIVISION 2-1 while Legacy lost to FURIA 1-2), and is not fed into the stale 2026-10-05 VRS model. No HotSpawn crowd split exists in the captured data, so no leaderboard fade is justified.
day3_fixtures.review_flag: Do not treat 63% as a live market line or confirmed HotSpawn pick; recheck the lobby and external books on the next scheduled refresh.

interpretation.aurora_9z: Do not mechanically chase 9z's day-one upset. Day two gives both sides relevant evidence: Aurora rebounded with a 2-0 win over NIP; 9z took one map off Falcons but lost the series. The day-three market still makes Aurora a clear favourite. 9z remains a plausible upset, reinforced by the day-one head-to-head win, but its current ownership-adjusted leverage does not clear the published leaderboard thresholds. Keep Aurora for both safe and leaderboard cards; flag the match as volatile rather than manufacturing a contrarian pick.
interpretation.betboom_legacy: The official schedule shows the other day-three decider, but it was not in the captured HotSpawn pick inventory. Day-two results point in opposite directions and the available equal EGW quote is not a dependable directional signal. A stale official VRS-derived line leans Legacy at about 63%, but this is model-only and should not be presented as a market pick; keep it explicitly separate pending a HotSpawn listing and fresh prices.

limitations: The official schedule lists matchups; it does not provide win probabilities.
The round-two Legacy-BetBoom rating model uses a 2026-10-05 official ranking snapshot and does not incorporate the October 15 results.
Day-two best-of-three results are small-sample form evidence, not proof of a changed underlying team strength.
The Aurora-9z crowd split is ownership only; it never enters probability estimation.
All live prices can move or expire before pick lock; open the current pick board rather than relying on this dated review.
